emergence.disease: Nephrogenic syndrome of inappropriate antidiuresis (NSIAD) -- AVPR2 gain-of-function (constitutively-active vasopressin V2 receptor; e.g. R137C/R137L, F229V, I130N)
emergence.summary: Nephrogenic syndrome of inappropriate antidiuresis (NSIAD) is the EXACT GAIN-of-function MIRROR of X-linked nephrogenic diabetes insipidus, on the SAME gene -- AVPR2, encoding the arginine-vasopressin V2 receptor (V2R), the Gs-coupled GPCR of the renal collecting-duct principal cell (chrXq28). Where X-linked NDI is AVPR2 LOSS-of-function (the V2R->cAMP->AQP2 water-reabsorption drive removed -> the duct cannot concentrate urine -> dilute polyuria, axis DOWN), NSIAD is AVPR2 GAIN-of-function: activating mutations render the V2R CONSTITUTIVELY ACTIVE, so it signals cAMP -> PKA -> apical AQP2 insertion -> water reabsorption WITHOUT vasopressin. The clinical picture mimics the syndrome of inappropriate antidiuresis (SIADH) -- hyponatraemia, concentrated urine, water retention -- but with UNDETECTABLE circulating vasopressin (hence NEPHROGENIC inappropriate antidiuresis), first described by Feldman 2005 (NEJM) in two male infants carrying R137C / R137L substitutions at the conserved DRY/DRH motif (TM3 / second intracellular loop). The kit reads this as the V2R->cAMP->AQP2 water-reabsorption DRIVE stuck ON (role accelerator -- the hormone-response drive -- mechanism GOF -> emergent axis UP on urine-concentrating throughput): the disease OVER-shoots and correction RESTRAINS the over-active receptor signal. This is the SAME cached AVPR2 promoter (gamma 1.4618) as X-linked NDI but the OPPOSITE perturbation, so the dwell ordering inverts -- NDI's disease dwell sits BELOW healthy, NSIAD's disease dwell sits ABOVE the same healthy value -- the EXACT analogue of the Rett (MECP2 LOF, axis DOWN) <-> MECP2-duplication (MECP2 GOF, axis UP) same-locus DIRECTION pair, now on a GPCR. It is the kit's SECOND GPCR / receptor-cAMP-signalling axis (consolidating the AVPR2 class opened by NDI) and COMPLETES the V2R axis in BOTH directions on one receptor (the GPCR analogue of the Wilson/Menkes copper pair, the LQT3/Dravet Na-channel pair, the haemophilia/antithrombin coagulation pair and the CLD/LEPR leptin pair). Correction = RESTRAIN the constitutive signal with a vaptan acting as an INVERSE AGONIST (e.g. tolvaptan), which suppresses the basal cAMP of the activated receptor and re-derives an APPROVED V2R-blocking drug as the direct on-target lever (target AVPR2 IS the primary switch). HONESTLY this is GENOTYPE-LIMITED, a beautifully sharp open-magnitude point: NSIAD constitutive activation comes in TWO molecular classes -- a VAPTAN-SENSITIVE class (F229V, I130N and others: high constitutive Gs/cAMP with normal/enhanced inverse-agonist responsiveness, so tolvaptan blocks the basal activity -- Tiulpakov 2016 showed tolvaptan suppresses the I130N mutant) and a VAPTAN-RESISTANT class confined to the Arg137 replacements (R137C/R137L: a sharp decline of ligand sensitivity at all transducer interactions, signalling partly through an alternative Rho-kinase/ROCK -> pT269-AQP2, beta-arrestin-2-biased route -- Ranieri 2020 -- so orthosteric vaptans do NOT suppress them). The Arg137 mutants are the COMMONEST NSIAD genotype, so although tolvaptan is the approved, on-target, mechanism-correct lever, its realised effect is GENOTYPE-DEPENDENT: vaptan-sensitive mutants respond, the common Arg137 mutants need an ALTERNATIVE (a ROCK-pathway restraint, investigational) -- the corrective DIRECTION (restrain the over-active V2R) is forced [F], the realised RESPONSIVENESS / magnitude is [O]. This is the honest approved-but-partial contrast to the same release's USH2A read (a clinical-not-approved Huntington-pattern lead) -- exactly as v0.22.0 paired choroideremia (clinical) with congenital hyperinsulinism (approved-but-genotype-limited). Fluid/osmolar restriction is supportive, not switch-level. direction_confidence = clean (accelerator x GOF -> axis UP gives an unambiguous corrective direction; the genotype-dependence is a MAGNITUDE/responsiveness [O] question, not a direction ambiguity -- exactly as NDI is clean despite genotype-dependent chaperone rescue). The gamma read is of the AVPR2 promoter switch STRUCTURE (chrXq28); the activating lesions (R137C/L, F229V, I130N) are coding, outside the promoter firewall. X-linked (hemizygous males; carrier females variable, B10 convention). Magnitude [O].
emergence.emergent_axis: renal collecting-duct urine-concentrating drive -- the vasopressin V2 receptor (V2R) -> Gs -> cAMP -> PKA -> AQP2 apical water-channel insertion axis. AVPR2 GOF (constitutive V2R activity) drives water reabsorption WITHOUT vasopressin (axis UP) -> hyponatraemia / water retention with undetectable AVP. The EXACT GAIN-of-function mirror of X-linked NDI's loss on the SAME receptor, and the kit's SECOND GPCR / second-messenger (cAMP) receptor-signalling axis

per_gene.note: AVPR2 encodes the arginine-vasopressin V2 receptor (V2R), a Gs-coupled GPCR in the renal collecting duct that transduces vasopressin -> cAMP -> AQP2 apical insertion -> water reabsorption. ACTIVATING (GOF) mutations make the V2R CONSTITUTIVELY ACTIVE -- it signals without vasopressin (accelerator/GOF -> axis UP) -> NSIAD (hyponatraemia, concentrated urine, undetectable AVP). The SAME cached locus as X-linked NDI (AVPR2 LOF) but the opposite perturbation. chrXq28. NCBI official symbol AVPR2. NSIAD = OMIM 300539. Coding lesions (R137C/L, F229V, I130N); promoter firewall respected.
per_gene.src: Feldman 2005 NEJM 352:1884 (R137C/R137L activating AVPR2 mutations cause NSIAD); Carpentier 2012 J Am Soc Nephrol 23:1635 (F229V); Tiulpakov 2016 Mol Cell Endocrinol 372:116 (I130N constitutive activity)

treatment_A_switch.disease: Nephrogenic syndrome of inappropriate antidiuresis (NSIAD) -- AVPR2 gain-of-function (constitutively-active vasopressin V2 receptor; e.g. R137C/R137L, F229V, I130N)

levers.push_direction: suppress the constitutive V2R signal with a vaptan acting as an INVERSE AGONIST -> lower basal cAMP -> reduce inappropriate AQP2 insertion / water reabsorption (axis DOWN toward normal). A DIRECT lever -- the target AVPR2 IS the primary switch -- re-deriving an APPROVED V2R-blocking drug
levers.mechanism_grade: [O] tolvaptan is an APPROVED vaptan (for hyponatraemia / SIADH) and the direct, mechanism-correct on-target lever, but its realised effect in NSIAD is GENOTYPE-DEPENDENT: vaptan-SENSITIVE mutants (F229V, I130N) are suppressed by tolvaptan, whereas the COMMONEST Arg137 (R137C/L) mutants are vaptan-RESISTANT (sharp loss of ligand sensitivity) -- so the corrective DIRECTION is forced [F] but the realised responsiveness / serum-sodium-normalisation magnitude is [O]; tolvaptan is an approved drug but NOT NSIAD-labelled (used for the hyponatraemia)
levers.src: Tiulpakov 2016 Mol Cell Endocrinol 372:116 (tolvaptan blocks basal cAMP of I130N V2R); Feldman 2005 NEJM 352:1884 (Arg137 constitutive activation)

levers.push_direction: for the vaptan-RESISTANT Arg137 mutants, restrain the ALTERNATIVE constitutive route the activated receptor uses (Rho-kinase/ROCK -> pT269-AQP2) -> lower AQP2 membrane targeting (axis DOWN toward normal)
levers.agent_class: Rho-kinase (ROCK) pathway restraint (investigational; mechanistic, not a developed therapy)
levers.mechanism_grade: [O] a cell-system mechanistic finding (R137L/C signal partly via ROCK -> pT269-AQP2, reduced by a ROCK inhibitor) -- NOT a developed or approved NSIAD therapy; magnitude/responsiveness not derived; direction [F]
levers.src: Ranieri 2020 Cells 9:1354 (R137L V2R signals via ROCK; ROCK inhibitor lowers pT269-AQP2)

falsifiers.claim: AVPR2 GOF moves the collecting-duct urine-concentrating axis UP (constitutive V2R->cAMP->AQP2 drive)
falsifiers.falsifier: an activating AVPR2 allele that LOWERED basal cAMP / apical AQP2 / urine osmolality (no inappropriate antidiuresis) would refute the drive-stuck-ON (axis UP) read
falsifiers.measurable_by: basal (vasopressin-free) cAMP and apical AQP2 trafficking in AVPR2-GOF collecting-duct / heterologous cells; basal urine osmolality and plasma sodium by genotype

falsifiers.claim: RESTRAINING V2R signalling (vaptan inverse agonist) is the CORRECTIVE direction
falsifiers.falsifier: if a V2R inverse-agonist vaptan RAISED (rather than lowered) basal cAMP / AQP2 insertion / water retention in a vaptan-sensitive NSIAD mutant, the restrain-the-drive lever sign is wrong
falsifiers.measurable_by: basal cAMP / apical AQP2 / urine output and plasma sodium response to tolvaptan in a vaptan-sensitive (e.g. I130N / F229V) NSIAD model or patient
